method: static analysis only; nothing in the batch was executed

scope.note: Type 1 is dominated by rtf-analysis.json (80.4 MB). All files catalogued, hashed and format-identified in file_disposition.csv.

findings.title: RealLab is a 32-bit Visual Basic 6 native (p-code) Windows GUI application
findings.detail: real lab system.exe is a PE32 i386 GUI executable that imports only MSVBVM60.DLL (231 named imports) and carries a 'VB5!' VBHeader (runtime build 9782, revision 10). No p-code/native distinction is recoverable from the static header, but the VB6 runtime dependency and VB5! signature establish VB6 as the development platform.

findings.title: Two distinct builds of the main executable are present (V-ROOT-1.00 and v1.605)
findings.detail: real lab system.exe.json describes a 59,150,336-byte build (timestamp 1388267701 = 2013-12-28, sha256 12828D0A..., FileVersion 1.00). 'real lab system.exe (2).json' / pe-structure.json describe a 76,292,096-byte build (timestamp 1595435962 = 2020-07-22, sha256 C54CE6C8..., the v1.605 target). Both are PE32 i386 GUI with image base 0x400000 and sections .text/.data/.rsrc. They are NOT the same file.

findings.title: VB6 project 'Real_lab_system': 212 objects, 8026 methods, 198 forms + 66 DataReports
findings.detail: VBHeader.project_name = Real_lab_system; project_description = 'real lab system'; LCID 1033 (en-US). object_count = 212 (210 named). A second tool (objects.json) classifies 210 objects as 132 form + 9 module + 66 datareport + 3 class. The VBHeader form_count 198 = 132 forms + 66 DataReports, reconciling the two tool classifications exactly. 8,026 methods are declared across the project.

findings.title: Application is organised as per-domain result-entry forms and per-domain print DataReports
findings.detail: Object names follow a Result* / Report* convention per clinical discipline (Resultliver/Reportliver, Resultkidney, Resulturine/Reporturine, Resultsugar/ReportSugar, Resultlipids, resultculutre/reportculutres, ReportFatora, Reporttotal, Reporthistory, Reportinstrument, Reportsemen, statisReport, Reportqc, Reportcross, etc.). Core modules include labmain (71 methods), patientmain (84 methods), labdb and labdb1 (data access), tools, testmain, addpatient, barcode, phone, moneypaid, testrange, workpaper.

findings.title: Dual database architecture: SQL Server is the system of record; Access/Jet MDBs are the offline/branch mirror
findings.detail: dependency-inventory records ADO 2.7 (msado27.tlb, MSADODC.OCX, Provider=SQLOLEDB.1) and a live SQL Server 'Patients' catalog (InitialCatalog=Patients in BASE.ini and data_connection*.udl). It separately records seven Jet 3 (Access 97) .mdb files as an offline workstation cache / branch data store. Type 2 evidence (the Access schemas) therefore describes the mirror, not the primary store.

findings.title: Third-party VB6 UI control packs and Microsoft OCX dependencies
findings.detail: external_component_count = 25 in the VBHeader. Named controls include ChamaleonButton.ocx (144 typelib members), RgheedButtonControlV2.ocx (100), XP_BUTTONS.ocx (114), vkUserControlsXP.ocx (524), Redsoul911XPCOmponents.ocx (410), plus Microsoft MSCOMCTL/MSCOMCT2/COMDLG32/RICHTX32/MSCOMM32/MSFLXGRD/MSCHRT20/MSADODC/MSDATGRD/MSDATLST/MSDBRPT and vendor NOTEX.dll / REPORT.dll.

findings.title: Outbound integrations: SMTP e-mail, smsmisr.com SMS gateway, serial-port analysers
findings.detail: A .NET 4.0 VB.NET component 'RealLab E-Mail Sender.exe' sends mail via SmtpClient. The main exe contains an smsmisr.com HTTP (cleartext) SMS API call with username/password in the query string (offset 0x27d79a). MSCOMM32.OCX indicates serial-port I/O for laboratory analysers; a UDL references an 'AUTOMATIC HEMATOLOGY ANALYZER ... BF6500' catalog. These are evidence-supported but were not runtime-verified.

findings.title: Shipped help is an Arabic (RTL) HTML Help 4.74 CHM with 17 topics and 79 images
findings.detail: real lab system help.chm: HTML Help Workshop 4.74.8702, topic_count 17, image_count 79, TOC in Arabic. Copyright topic reads 'Copyright: ais group corporation 2010. All rights reserved.' Topics cover installation, login, patient registration, result entry, reports, backup and notes.

findings.title: Report layout is driven by 146 per-test INI files plus a 228-template RTF cache
findings.detail: ini-analysis.json analyses 146 .ini files (Data\*.ini), each with sections reportdata/setupx (and often FORM/report), defining reportmaintitle, subtitles, symbols, fonts and print flags. report_maintitles include MICROBIOLOGY REPORT, MOLECULAR BIOLOGY REPORT, HEMATOLOGY REPORT, IMMUNOLOGY/ENDOCRINOLOGY/CYTOPATHOLOGY/SEROLOGY/BIOCHEMISTRY REPORT. A separate RTF template corpus of 228 cached report templates (template-corpus-228.json) provides the printable layouts.

findings.title: Barcode and Arabic display fonts are shipped as first-party assets
findings.detail: asset-analysis.json lists 47 assets including barcode fonts FREE3OF9.TTF, WBCW_UPCEAN.ttf, WBCWS_UPCEAN.ttf, Arabic fonts MCS Taybah.ttf / ais lab.ttf / ais symbol.ttf, and Digiface.ttf. The 146 INI files reference Arial (675), Tahoma (597) and Times New Roman (328).

findings.title: Executable resources: 10 icons + 1 group icon + 1 VERSION resource; no ASLR/DEP
findings.detail: pe-resources.json enumerates 10 ICON entries (incl. 69,012-byte 256x256 icon and 67,624-byte icon), one GROUP_ICON and one VERSION resource. pe-structure.json reports characteristics 0x010f, DllCharacteristics 0x0000 (ASLR=false, DEP/NX=false), SEH=true, CFG=false. This matches the consolidated security finding that the legacy binaries ship without modern mitigations.

findings.title: Component dependency map (B3 slice): 6 components, 9 confirmed dependencies, 31 .NET assembly refs
findings.detail: components.json (B3) catalogues 6 components; dependencies.json records runtime_platform, 9 confirmed dependencies, 2 possible and 4 unresolved; dependency-inventory.json lists 20 external components, 5 framework dependencies, 31 .NET assembly references and 6 analyst tools. These describe the deployment/runtime surface rather than internal call graph.

findings.title: Media asset: RLS_Learn.wmv training video (85 MB ASF/WMV)
findings.detail: asf-metadata.json analyses RLS_Learn.wmv (85,279,236 bytes), an ASF container with 2 streams, confirming the product ships an instructional video.

limitations: No binary was executed; all findings are static.
Method bodies were not decompiled; method names/counts come from the VB6 object table only.
The p-code vs native-code distinction of the VB6 build was not resolved from the static header.
runtime_build 9782 is the VB6 SP6 runtime build; the exact VB6 service-pack level of the build toolchain is inferred, not proven.
Duplicate artefacts ('... (2).json') are byte-identical re-analyses where hashes match; the two exe JSONs are NOT duplicates but two different builds (see FIND-T1-002).
